status: DESCRIPTIVE CARRIER TRACE — NO TARGET, NO THRESHOLD, NO RUN
question: What bounds absolute candidate K once every candidate edge is already a member of the temporal cycle graph?
definition: A per-cycle replay of all 18 no-arm seeds. Each cycle reconstructs every 2-cycle and 3-cycle, ranks them by the engine's own key, and checks the top 15 against the returned loop ids. It records eligibility, best rank, top-15 appearances and K for every candidate edge, and separates engine-wide directed K from the one-orientation candidate-stream K used by A1.
method: Same worlds, 120 cycles, cap 40 and acquisition schedule as the baseline availability replay. No cap is raised and no engine file is edited. The reconstruction must match every returned loop id and the stored candidate K count, or the build refuses.
not_evidence: A replay-only trace on 18 committed no-arm seeds, two world families and one build. It shows which edges enter the capped loop readout and which do not; it does not raise the loop cap, does not show that raising it would increase K, and establishes no causal, capability, retention or transfer claim.
